question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Esoteric
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. Common.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Esoteric"** means something that is intended for or likely to be understood by only a small number of people with a specialized knowledge or interest. (गूढ़)
 
 
• **Example:** The professor's lecture on quantum mechanics was so esoteric that only a few students could follow it.
 
 
• **"Common"** refers to something that is known or understood by many people; it is not rare or specialized. (सामान्य)
 
 
• **Example:** The flu is a common illness that affects millions of people every year.
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Esoteric'** is **'Common'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. Common.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Arcane **(गोपनीय): Understood by few; mysterious or secret.
 
 
• **Example:** The arcane rituals of the ancient tribe were known only to a few elders.
 
 
 
• **Cryptic **(संदिग्ध): Having a meaning that is mysterious or obscure.
 
 
• **Example:** His cryptic response left everyone in the room puzzled.
 
 
 
• **Abstruse **(कठिन): Difficult to understand; obscure.
 
 
• **Example:** The philosopher's abstruse theories were difficult for the average person to comprehend.
